articles.summary: 100% of the Hammer Price of the Iconic 1975 MasterCraft Stars Stripes Boat with Matching Custom Chevrolet Colorado by RealTruck will go to Building Homes for Heroes Multi-Platinum Selling Country Singer Warren Zeiders Will Step Onto the Auction Block to Help Sell the Pairing MasterCraft Boat Company , a subsidiary of MasterCraft Boat Holdings, Inc (NASDAQ: MCFT) and the best-selling towboat brand, and RealTruck , America's leading truck accessory brand, today announced at Specialty Equipment Market Association Show (SEMA) that the reimagined and customized Chevrolet Colorado paired with MasterCraft’s iconic 1975 “Stars Stripes” ski boat will be up for auction during Barrett-Jackson’s 2027 Scottsdale Auction, January 23-31 at WestWorld of Scottsdale. articles.summary: New and Expanded Dealer Partnerships Strengthen Brand Presence and Customer Access Across North America and Europe MasterCraft Boat Holdings, Inc. (MCBH) today announced continued dealer network expansion across its portfolio of brands during the Q1 2026 Transition Period, reflecting the company’s continued investment in its brands, distribution network, and long-term growth. Through new partnerships and expanded brand representation with established marine dealerships, MCBH is broadening customer access to its boats while strengthening its market position and building a foundation for future growth. “Expanding our dealer network is an important part of our long-term vision for MCBH and our family of brands,” said Brad Nelson, Chief Executive Officer of MasterCraft Boat Holdings. “By partnering with strong local dealers, we're making it easier for more boaters to experience our products with the support that makes boat ownership rewarding. articles.summary: MasterCraft Boat Holdings, Inc. (NASDAQ: MCFT) today announced financial results for the first three months of its transition period ended October 4, 2026. The overview, commentary, and results provided herein relate to our continuing operations, which consists of our Performance and Wake, Leisure, and Recreation and Sport Fishing segments. On May 15, 2026, the Company completed the merger with Marine Products (“Marine Products Transaction”). As a result, the Company recognized incremental net sales of $59.3 million within the Recreation and Sport Fishing segment during the first three months of the Transition Period (as defined below) compared to the first three months of fiscal 2026. Results for the three-month period ended October 4, 2026 were also impacted by acquisition and integration costs, including the change in fiscal year-end, associated with the Marine Products Transaction.
